notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.

Each LED i sits in two adjacent columns of the top half: anode (left leg) in the same column as its resistor, cathode in the next column. The resistor spans the centre gap in the anode column; a blue wire from the Uno pin enters the bottom half in that same column. This follows the circuit image and the schematic (pin -> 220 ohm resistor -> LED anode, cathode -> GND).
Pin mapping from the image: pin 7 -> LED1 (columns 7/8), pin 6 -> LED2 (10/11), pin 5 -> LED3 (13/14), pin 4 -> LED4 (16/17), pin 3 -> LED5 (19/20), pin 2 -> LED6 (22/23).

Each LED cathode column is wired by a short black wire to the top negative rail (tn), which a black wire from the Uno GND pin next to AREF (GND.1) feeds. Rail hole numbers are approximate; the rail is one strip.

The breadboard's row letters in the image are printed reversed relative to the catalogue's naming (top half a-e, bottom half f-j); catalogue naming is used. Resistors are placed in the top strip's row d and the bottom strip's row f, across the centre gap.
Every physical connection has both a joined and an electrical edge.
